    Execute a query against a PIC-SURE session.

    runQuery.Rd

    Runs a query — a clause/clause-group from [`buildClause()`][picsure::buildClause] / [`buildClauseGroup()`][picsure::buildClauseGroup], or a Query from [`buildQuery()`][picsure::buildQuery] — against the session's resource and returns the result in the shape dictated by `type`:

    Usage

    runQuery(session, query, type = "count", ...)

    Arguments

    session

    A session object produced by [`connect()`][picsure::connect].

    query

    A clause/clause-group handle (from [`buildClause()`][picsure::buildClause] / [`buildClauseGroup()`][picsure::buildClauseGroup]) or a Query handle (from [`buildQuery()`][picsure::buildQuery]).

    type

    A `QueryType` member (e.g. [`QueryType$COUNT`][picsure::QueryType]) or a case-insensitive string: `"count"` (default), `"participant"`, `"timestamp"`, or `"cross_count"`.

    ...

    Additional keyword arguments forwarded to the Python `Session.runQuery()` call.

    Value

    For `type = "count"`, a Python `CountResult` object with `$value` (exact count, or `NULL` for obfuscated small cohorts), `$margin`, and `$cap`. For `type = "cross_count"`, a dict-like mapping concept paths to CountResults. For `"participant"` and `"timestamp"`, a `data.frame`.

    Details

    - `"count"` — a `CountResult` object with `$value` (exact count, or `NULL` for obfuscated small cohorts), `$margin`, and `$cap`. - `"cross_count"` — a dict-like mapping of concept paths to `CountResult` objects. - `"participant"` — data.frame with one row per matching participant across all included concepts. - `"timestamp"` — data.frame of participant-level timestamps for longitudinal concepts.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
count <- picsure::runQuery(bdc, full_query, type = "count")
if (!is.null(count$value)) cat(count$value, "participants\n")

rows <- picsure::runQuery(bdc, full_query, type = "participant")
} # }
